# StudioAPI

> Unified API infrastructure. Sources across public data, OTA, marketplaces, and more normalized behind one consistent, agent-ready API. One key, one contract, one bill — for products and AI agents.

## Core facts

- Product: StudioAPI (studioapi.dev)
- Tagline: Many sources. One API. Every agent.
- Model: B2B SaaS — free developer tier, usage-based Scale tier, custom Enterprise tier
- Payment: credits, volume pricing, and x402 on-chain pay-per-call for agents
- Integration: REST + MCP-native + OpenAI-compatible function calling

## Links

- Landing page: https://studioapi.dev
- Dashboard: https://studioapi-app.pages.dev
- Documentation: https://studioapi-docs.pages.dev
- Source: https://github.com/khmuhtadin/studioapi

## Capabilities for agents

- Every endpoint is exposed as an MCP tool.
- Tool schemas are OpenAI/Anthropic function-calling compatible.
- Multi-source failover returns one consistent response.
- SSE streaming is available for long agent runs.
- x402 receipts let agents pay per request on-chain.
- Keys can be scoped per agent with budgets and audit logs.
